note_zh: 線索：長樂外海首台東方電氣 10 MW 機組（2021-08-05 由「海電運維801」吊裝）輪轂中心高 118 m（長樂區政府轉人民日報客戶端），但文中未寫是 A 區或 C 區，且 A 區另有 14 台 6.7 MW、13 台 8 MW，輪轂高度未查到。全國溫室氣體自願減排（CCER）登記平台的公開資料寫 A 區理論水深 39–44 m、37 台（6.7／8／10 MW），但只能經 POST 介面讀取，無法以 check_quotes 核對；其項目設計文件 A.3 節「依風機銘牌修改技術參數」，檔案需登入才能下載。
note_en: Lead: the first Dongfang 10 MW unit in the Changle offshore area (installed 5 Aug 2021 by Haidian Yunwei 801) has a 118 m hub centre (Changle district government, from People's Daily app), but the article does not say whether it is zone A or C, and zone A's 14 x 6.7 MW and 13 x 8 MW hubs were not found. The national CCER registry's public record gives zone A a theoretical depth of 39-44 m and 37 turbines (6.7/8/10 MW), but it is only served through a POST API that check_quotes cannot read; its project design document (section A.3, technical parameters revised from the nameplates) needs a login.
why: No farm-wide as-built hub: only one 10 MW unit of unclear zone. The zone A sea-use change report (Fuzhou natural resources & planning bureau, zygh.fuzhou.gov.cn .../ghbggs/202409/P020240914550803041701.pdf) now returns 404 and is not archived; the provincial change approval (zrzyt.fujian.gov.cn, Jan 2026) has no turbine data. ccer.cets.org.cn files need login; eps.ctg.com.cn / ctgne.com cut TLS; web.archive.org CDX blocked by egress policy.

sources.quote: 本次吊装的风机为东方电气10MW风电机组，发电机重量达270吨（不含吊具和支架重量），轮毂中心高度达到118米，单只叶片长度90米。同时，项目风场水深45米、入泥深度超22米以及风浪大等艰难施工环境

issues: Foundation note: the Changle I (south) EIA (Fuzhou ecology, Nov 2025) describes zone A as 37 foundations, 22 four-leg jackets and 15 suction-bucket jackets, consistent with the current 'jk'.

issue_sources.quote: （1）长乐外海海上风电场A 区项目概况：长乐外海海上风电场A 区项目施 工作业内容主要为37 台风机基础施工及安装工程的建设施工，四桩导管架22 台，吸力式导管架15 台，已建成。

note_zh: 線索：C 區實建 37 台 8 MW（上海電氣）＋20 台東方電氣 10 MW（長樂外海 I 區（南）環評報告書所述）。長樂區政府轉載的首台東方電氣 10 MW 吊裝新聞寫輪轂中心高 118 m、風場水深 45 m（與 C 區水深較吻合，但文中未寫明區別），8 MW 機型輪轂高度未查到，無法給全場範圍。CCER 公開資料寫機位與升壓站水深 31–48 m，但只能經 POST 介面讀取，無法核對。
note_en: Lead: zone C was built with 37 x 8 MW (Shanghai Electric) + 20 x Dongfang 10 MW (Changle I south EIA). The Changle district article on the first Dongfang 10 MW installation gives a 118 m hub centre and 45 m water depth (closer to zone C's depth, but the zone is not named); the 8 MW units' hub height was not found, so no farm-wide range. The CCER public record gives 31-48 m depth at the turbine and substation positions, but only through a POST API that cannot be checked.
why: 8 MW (37 units) hub missing; the 10 MW source does not name the zone. Changle C acceptance-related files are blocked: oss.yanshougs.com (403, 220 kV export acceptance report), wind.imarine.cn (403, commissioning news giving depth 41-47 m), fzcl.gov.cn 2022 EIA/acceptance notice (404), ccer.cets.org.cn documents (login).

sources.quote: 本次吊装的风机为东方电气10MW风电机组，发电机重量达270吨（不含吊具和支架重量），轮毂中心高度达到118米，单只叶片长度90米。同时，项目风场水深45米、入泥深度超22米以及风浪大等艰难施工环境

issues: Turbine field (37x 8 MW + 20x Dongfang 10 MW) is confirmed by the Changle I (south) EIA: batch 1 had 25 x 8 MW, batch 2 12 x 8 MW + 20 x 10 MW.

issue_sources.quote: （2）长乐外海海上风电场C 区项目概况：长乐外海海上风电场C 区项目第 一批包括1 座海上升压站导管架基础施工、25 台8.0MW 吸力式导管架基础施工 及风机安装；第二批包括32 台吸力式导管架基础施工及12 台8MW、20 台10MW 风机机组安装，已建成。

note_zh: 未查到東海大橋二期（27 台上海電氣 3.6 MW＋1 台華銳 5 MW）的建成輪轂高度；中文維基只寫二期機組容量，英文維基的東海大橋條目只有一期（SL3000/90，輪轂 91 m）。
note_en: No as-built hub height found for Donghai Bridge phase II (27 x Shanghai Electric 3.6 MW + 1 x Sinovel 5 MW); Chinese Wikipedia only gives the phase II unit sizes and the English Donghai Bridge article covers phase I only (SL3000/90, 91 m hub).
why: Searched NEA, Wikipedia (zh/en), Shanghai government and news; eastwp.net acceptance news returned 502; no acceptance report found.

note_zh: 未查到 14 台樣機（8 家廠商、5–6.7 MW）逐型號的建成輪轂高度。福建省政府 2026-03 已批覆「福清興化灣海上風電場一期項目變更用海」，但批覆不含風機參數，變更論證報告書未在省自然資源廳或福州市網站找到。
note_en: No as-built hub heights found for the 14 prototypes (8 makers, 5-6.7 MW). The Fujian government approved a changed sea use for Xinghua Bay phase 1 in Mar 2026, but the approval has no turbine data and the change report itself was not found on the provincial or Fuzhou sites.
why: Mixed models need every model's hub; none found. Change report not published on zrzyt.fujian.gov.cn (WAS search of all channels); Fuzhou planning site search API resets connections.

note_zh: 未查到「國能共享號」4 MW 浮式機組距海面的輪轂高度；國資委、國家能源集團、央視等報導只寫平台尺寸（三立柱半潛式、立柱高 24／28 m、吃水 14 m）。CCER 公開資料寫水深約 35 m、2024-06-19 併網（與現有水深一致）。
note_en: No hub height above sea level found for the Guoneng Gongxiang 4 MW floating unit; SASAC, CHN Energy and CCTV reports give only platform dimensions (three-column semi-sub, 24/28 m columns, 14 m draft). The CCER public record gives about 35 m depth and grid connection on 19 Jun 2024 (matching the current depth).
why: No source states the hub height; shanghai-electric.com returned HTTP 521.

note_zh: 華潤蒼南 1# 擴容工程海域使用論證報告書（2023-08，已建 24 台 6.25 MW＋25 台 10 MW）只寫基礎與海纜，無輪轂高度；CPEM 寫最後一台葉輪「在 117 米高空」對接，屬吊裝高度，不採用。
note_en: The Cangnan 1 expansion sea-use report (Aug 2023; built part 24 x 6.25 MW + 25 x 10 MW) covers foundations and cables but no hub height; CPEM's 'rotor joined at 117 m' is a lifting height and is not used.
why: Cangnan county site (www.cncn.gov.cn, 2025 EIA notice for the expansion) resets the connection; MSA navigation notices (msa.gov.cn) return 403.

note_en: No as-built hub height or rotor found for either model at Zhuanghe IV1 (25 x 6.2 MW + 26 x 7.5 MW); SASAC, Xinhua and runsky give only capacities and the 30 m average depth.
why: news.qq.com (501) and nengapp.com (502) pages failed; wind.imarine.cn 403.

note_en: No as-built hub height found for Fengxian's 32 x 6.45 MW; Power Technology lists phase IA as 16 x MingYang MySE6.45-180 and phase IB as 16 x Goldwind GW184/6450, so both models would be needed.
why: News (CCCC Third Harbour, NEA quality station, Jiemian) gives no hub; no acceptance report found.
issues: Turbine field '32x 6.45 MW' could name the two models: 16 MingYang MySE6.45-180 + 16 Goldwind GW184/6450 (Power Technology).

note_zh: 英文維基百科「中國離岸風場列表」：臨港示範二期 101 MW、28 台上海電氣 W3600-122-90（3.6 MW），水深 5–7 m、離岸 10 km、2016 年；只採用水深。輪轂高度未查到（型號尾碼 90 可能是輪轂高度，但沒有出處明寫，不採用；葉輪直徑也不取型號數字）。維基此列的出處是 4C Offshore，水深與臨港一期相同，主程式可自行決定是否採用。
note_en: English Wikipedia 'List of offshore wind farms in China': Lingang demonstration phase 2, 101 MW, 28 x Sewind W3600-122-90 (3.6 MW), depth 5-7 m, 10 km offshore, 2016; only the depth is used. Hub height not found (the '-90' suffix may be the hub height but no source states it, and the rotor is not taken from the model name). Wikipedia's reference for this row is 4C Offshore and the depth equals phase 1's, so the main session may prefer not to adopt it.
why: Hub: no as-built source; Wikipedia gives only the model string.

note_en: No as-built hub height found for Daishan 4 (36 x 4.5 MW east, 18 x 4 MW west); a search summary's '128 m rotor, 85 m hub' comes from pre-construction reports (design values, and inconsistent with the EN148), not used.
why: CCER project record exists (terminated) but files need login; no acceptance report found; wind.in-en.com closes connections.

note_zh: 線索：中鐵大橋局（澎湃號，2021-10）：其負責的標段 25 台中，32 號機葉片長 84 m、旋轉直徑 175 m、輪轂距海平面 105 m；全場 50 台 6 MW。Power Technology 卻寫 50 台上海電氣 SWT-6.0-154（葉輪 154 m），與 175 m 矛盾，無法確認全場為同一機型，故只列線索。
note_en: Lead: China Railway Major Bridge (The Paper, Oct 2021): in its lot of 25 turbines, unit 32 has 84 m blades, a 175 m rotation diameter and its hub 105 m above sea level; the farm has 50 x 6 MW. Power Technology instead lists 50 x Shanghai Electric SWT-6.0-154 (154 m rotor), which conflicts with 175 m, so it is not confirmed that the whole farm uses one model.
why: Single unit / single lot; turbine model conflict (175 m vs SWT-6.0-154). The 2019 turbine tender (one lot, Shanghai Electric first candidate) is on bjx.com.cn, which returns a stub; MSA completion notice (沪航通〔2023〕0366号) is 403.

共50台单机容量6兆瓦风力发电机组，装机总容量为300兆瓦。
